## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a free-text statement of an organization's purpose, mission, or objective when no structured goal model is needed.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it where the purpose is a first-class goal with structure (model that on the teleology/intention layer) — this is a solver-side free-text summary ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:organizationPurpose`](gmeow-organizationPurpose.md) to a language-tagged literal; promote to a structured goal construct when the objective must bear sub-goals, evidence, or standpoint.

### Examples

- ex:acme [`gmeow:organizationPurpose`](gmeow-organizationPurpose.md) "To manufacture reliable widgets."@en.
